messages:
Ash: FYI billing dashboard spike for user 4520 — looks like double token charge when stream reconnect + toolcall. Anyone else seeing this?
Maria: saw it. traces show stream replay + new trace_id so billing double-counts.
Liam: dug into logs, sequence: stream_start -> stream_chunk x3 -> tool_call -> client reconnect -> stream_chunk x2 (same prefix). charge_id different. router replay maybe.
Jen: router log sample: ```json
{"stream_id":"s-abc","trace_id":"t-123","event":"stream_chunk","offset":512}
```
Ash: billing-service dedupe uses (trace_id,event,offset) window 10s. reconnects make new trace_id -> no dedupe.
Maria: idea: use stable key (stream_id + prefix_hash) to identify replayed chunks across trace_ids. prefix_hash = sha256(prefix_bytes).
Liam: caveat: prefix_bytes may be partial because clients send chunked frames; also some proxies trim leading bytes.
Paul: saw a variant where routing fallback to another model mid-stream caused tokens to be counted on both models. not strictly replay but duplicate attribution.
Jen: console UX idea: flag 'probable-duplicate' in per-request table and expose `credit_basis` in logs.
Ash: quick mitigation: billing pipeline could mark credits as `provisional` if same user+session+prefix_hash seen within 2m, then finalize on EOF. reduces immediate over-billing.
Liam: that delays billing finality — could be knobbed by rollout percent.
Maria: propose canary 5% traffic for enterprise accounts. add `provisional_credit_rate` metric + alert if it grows.
Jen: telemetry sample to emit for billing: ```yaml
event: token_charge
user_id: 4520
stream_id: s-abc
prefix_hash: h-1a2b3c
charge_id: c-999
status: provisional
reason: retry_replay
```
Paul: another edge: toolcalls that synthesize tokens server-side (eg web_search results) must be attributed differently from original prompt tokens. otherwise we under/over-charge.
Liam: recommend adding `origin_stream_id` and `toolcall_offset` fields on toolcall charge events so billing can split attribution.
Ash: action items: 1) Maria write prefix_hash proto + spec, 2) Jen add dashboard & alert panels, 3) Liam add router header `X-Prefix-Hash` and advertise in docs, 4) Paul implement provisional_credit logic in billing pipeline. I'll open PRs and link here.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: billing-provisional-feature -> staging at commit sha abc123
Maria: created draft `specs/prefix-dedup.md`, pinging in #eng-docs when ready.
Jen: will slot canary into rollout playbook and add runbook steps. :thumbsup:
